title: fix(lint)!: type a time-relative flow's conditions against its swept object when the start names no objectName, and let validate_expression take the swept object
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-bill"} -->
_Requested by **Bill** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_016iMXWSZDzqWRWvWzdNo8wg?thread=cmsg_016iMXWSZDzqWRWvWzdNo8wg1bQRcYtBcNuyy3fjtaaNaz)_

domain:server#2 · os-bill · session_01Utp6CaUg3ibF939L2RFB5D

Fixes #30026

Clause-②: yes (narrowing) — the author-time gate (`os build`, `os validate`, the package publish and the flow publish door) refuses, in the start, edge and `decision` conditions of a time-relative flow whose start node names no `objectName`, a `type-mismatch` (`type-mismatch-run-fails`), a `record.FIELD` read of a field the swept object does not declare (`unknown field`), and date arithmetic (`date-arithmetic-run-fails` / `date-text-arithmetic-run-fails`), which it passed with no verdict at all before. Added beside it (the widening half): the optional `sweepObject` input of the `validate_expression` MCP tool.
Metadata-protocol: narrowed
Skills-docs: updated here — the MCP skill text in `packages/mcp/src/skill-md.ts` (the new `sweepObject` input); `skills/**` teaches no time-relative flow condition with a text-vs-number comparison, so no skill or eval moves.

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么：时间相对（定时扫描）流程的开始节点不写 `objectName`、只在 `timeRelative.object` 写了被扫描的对象时，条件现在按被扫描对象的字段做类型检查，文本与数字比较会被发布拦下（以前完全不检查）；开始节点写的对象与扫描对象不一致时，仍只给警告，但会多一条说明告诉作者为什么、怎么改；MCP 的 `validate_expression` 新增可选输入 `sweepObject`，能给出与发布门一致的判决。
- 为什么改：这类流程每次运行拿到的 `record` 就是被扫描对象的一行，条件里文本与数字比较每次都会让运行失败，但发布时一声不吭；另外 #30015 的注释和测试描述了一个根本绑不上的形状（不写 `timeRelative.object`）。
- 风险与回滚：只收窄一种形状的发布（BREAKING 已在 changeset 写明 FROM → TO），已登记的 ADR-0087 语义条目覆盖同一修法；其余流程判决不变；回滚即撤 PR。
- 先看：`packages/lint/src/validate-expressions.ts` 流程遍历开头的 `objectName = startObject ?? sweepObject` 与 `sweepsTypedObject`，同文件流程末尾的说明警告；`packages/mcp/src/mcp-http-tools.ts` 的 `sweepObject` 输入与 `flow_condition` 判决。
- 两分钟验证：`pnpm --filter @objectstack/lint exec vitest run --maxWorkers=2 src/validate-expressions.test.ts -t "time-relative"`，预期 3 个用例通过，其中 `tr_sweep_only` 三处条件均为 error。
- 需要你做的：无，席位落地（收窄面由席位安排 CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER 复审）。

## What changes

- **Lint — the typed object of a flow** (`validateStackExpressions`, the flow walk). The object a flow's conditions are typed against is the start node's `objectName`, else, on a time-relative flow, `timeRelative.object`. `TimeRelativeTriggerSchema` requires that key, and `time-relative-trigger.ts` launches every run with a row of that object as `record` (`engine.find(desc.object, …)`, then `{ record: row }`), whatever the start node names. So a sweep whose start names no `objectName` is now typed against the swept object at every flow site that reads the typed object: start, edge and `decision` conditions (field existence, the type check with the `run-fails` outcome, `record.FIELD` reads), the shadowed-variable warning, and the root check's did-you-mean order. The null-guard twin is unchanged (record-triggered flows only).
- **Lint — `sweepsTypedObject`** is now `timeRelative.object === typed object` and nothing else. The old "else the start node's" arm graded a descriptor with no `object` as a sweep of the start object; that descriptor never binds (`flow-time-relative-descriptor-invalid`, error), so no run of it binds a row and it now gets no declared outcome (the warning). The ledger comment says so.
- **Lint — why a sweep of another object only warns.** When the start node's `objectName` is not `timeRelative.object`, the `type-mismatch-run-may-fail` warning stays, and the flow gets one more warning at `flows[i].nodes[j].config.objectName` saying why: the conditions are checked against the start object's fields while each run's record is a row of the swept one; set `objectName` to the swept object or remove it. It is pushed once per flow, and only when the flow was served a `type-mismatch-run-may-fail` warning (counted in `check()` by that one `code`). The date verdicts' `-run-may-fail` arm (#30016) is not counted: it is an error whatever the outcome, so the sweep softens nothing there and there is nothing to explain; a pin says so.
- **MCP — `validate_expression` takes `sweepObject`** (optional; site `flow_condition` with `triggerKind: 'time_relative'` only, a tool error anywhere else, the same refusal shape as `severity` / `triggerKind`). It is the flow's `timeRelative.object`; another object than `objectName` gives the gate's warning instead of the run-fails error. The `flow_condition` outcome reads a third input, `sweepsTypedObject`, the lint ledger's own third fact. The tool description and the MCP skill text (`skill-md.ts`) name the input.
- **What else the typed object refuses.** Typed against the swept object, a sweep-only flow also gets the two other verdicts a sweep of the start object gets, both new refusals there: a `record.FIELD` read of a field the swept object does not declare (`unknown field FIELD on OBJECT`), and arithmetic on a date field (`date-arithmetic-run-fails`). Both are pinned, and both are in the changeset's Clause-② sentence and FROM → TO.
- **Tests.** The `tr_default` pin (a descriptor with no `object`, a shape that cannot bind) is re-purposed to `tr_sweep_only`: a start with no `objectName` sweeping `crm_opportunity`, refused at start, decision and edge. New pins: the note on `tr_other` (once, its `where`, `path` and `source`) and its absence on a clean `tr_other`, on `tr_same` and on `tr_sweep_only`; a well-typed `tr_sweep_only` flow is clean. The MCP per-trigger-kind table gains three rows (`sweepObject` = `objectName`, start with no `objectName`, `sweepObject` another object), each asserted equal to the gate's own verdict on the same flow, and the wrong-site refusal list gains four `sweepObject` calls. The key-read meta-test now lists `id` on `startNode` (the note names the start node).
- **Changeset** `.changeset/30026-time-relative-sweep-typing.md`, `minor` on `@objectstack/lint` and `@objectstack/mcp`, BREAKING with FROM → TO, ADR-0087 `already-registered flow-record-read-and-decision-type-mismatch-refused`, and a correction note for the released #30015 changeset text ("or is omitted"), which is left as is.

## Acceptance notes

- **ADR-0087 disposition.** `already-registered flow-record-read-and-decision-type-mismatch-refused`: the entry prescribes this exact rewrite for a time-relative flow's conditions (same code, same replacement, same reason). Its `surface` text says "sweeping the start node's objectName", which this change makes narrower than the gate; editing it is `packages/spec/**`, outside this card's surface. The seat files it for `domain:spec`.
- **A sweep of another object is still typed against the start object.** Field reads are judged against the start object too, so a `record.FIELD` read of a field only the swept object declares is still refused as unknown there, while the run would hold it. That is pre-existing and not made worse here; the new note tells the author to align the two objects, which removes it.
- **The engine's binding fallback.** `deriveTriggerBinding` (`plugin-extension-api.ts`) still names `config.objectName` as the binding's `object` when `timeRelative.object` is absent. The sweep itself reads only the parsed descriptor, so no run depends on it; noted, not touched.

## Verification

All readings on head `52faf73c` (merged with `main` at `959c26be`; the merge resolves the `validate-expressions.test.ts` conflict with #30016 by keeping both sides' tests) unless named.

<details><summary>Build, typecheck, tests</summary>

- Build: `pnpm --filter '@objectstack/lint^...' --filter '@objectstack/mcp^...' build`, VERDICT command-exit 0; full `turbo run build --filter='!@objectstack/docs'`, 119/119 tasks, VERDICT command-exit 0.
- `@objectstack/lint`: `pnpm test` 8006/8006 (193 files); `pnpm typecheck` 0 (with `check:test-typecheck`).
- `@objectstack/mcp`: `pnpm test` 678/678 (56 files); `pnpm typecheck` 0 (with `check:test-typecheck`).
- `eslint --no-inline-config` over the five changed source and test files: 0. The repo-wide `pnpm lint` is CI's.

</details>

<details><summary>Ablations (each through scripts/ablation-replace.mjs; restored blob == HEAD, `git diff HEAD` empty)</summary>

- A1, lint source (the lint suite imports `src`): `objectName = startObject ?? sweepObject` → `startObject`. 2 red on `52faf73c`: `tr_sweep_only: expected [] to deeply equal [ …3 ]`, the pre-fix answer (no verdict at all), and the unknown-field / date-arithmetic pin. (On `bc376239`, before that pin existed: 1 red.)
- A2 (on `bc376239`; the MCP sources are unchanged since), lint `dist/` (the MCP suite reads `@objectstack/lint` through its exports): the same mutation with a string marker, lint rebuilt, `ablation-dist-preflight` present in 4 built files; 1 red: `time_relative, start names no objectName: expected [] to have a length of 1`. Restore leg rebuilt, preflight `--absent` over all 20 built files, suite 38/38.
- A3 (on `bc376239`), MCP source: `sweepsTypedObject` forced `true`. 1 red: `sweepObject another object: expected [ [ 'error', … ] ] to deeply equal [ [ 'warning', … ] ]`.

</details>

<details><summary>Derived gates</summary>

- `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands --repo objectstack-ai/objectstack` on `52faf73c`: 59 families; all 59 run, each exit 0 (exit code captured per line before any pipe).
- `--ran` reconciliation: "59 derived famil(ies) accounted for — 59 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED".

</details>

<details><summary>Dogfood (the narrowing arm's battery, on the final head)</summary>

- On `52faf73c`, after a full `turbo run build --filter='!@objectstack/docs'` (119/119): `pnpm --filter @objectstack/dogfood test` under the lock, no shard, no path: Test Files 418/422 passed (3 skipped, 1 failed), Tests 3491 passed, 36 skipped, 1 failed; VERDICT command-exit 1.
- The one red is `permission-set-clone-door.dogfood.test.ts` › "a platform set … copies into its shipping package's pair": cloning `member_default` answers 422, `objects.sys_comment` / `objects.sys_activity` not defined in the target package. It is not this change: with `validate-expressions.ts`, `mcp-http-tools.ts` and `skill-md.ts` set back to `origin/main` and lint and mcp rebuilt, the same file is red the same way (1 failed / 10 passed; control taken on `bc376239`). The seat tracks it as #30255, with its revert in the merge queue. The grants arrived on `main` with #30222 (`490d136f`, "every member reads and posts comments, and reads the activity history"), inside this branch's base.

</details>
